items.summary: A new method called Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration aims to improve the efficiency of training sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models on memory-constrained nodes by addressing uneven workload distribution, which is crucial for enhancing performance in Web applications.

The broader impact includes improved performance and scalability for web applications relying on MoE models, particularly in environments with limited memory resources.
